Backup and recovery

Backups preserve recoverable copies. Recovery restores data and may replay logs; test restores and
define RPO/RTO.
Backup එක data copy එකක් තබනවා. Recovery එJකන් ඒ data නැවත ගෙන්නවා. Backup තිබුණාට
Recover a database after an accidental deletion.
Live database → Backup + logs → Restore to test server
Follow the arrows to see how the related objects or operations connect.
Diagram එJක් boxes සහ arrows අනුව සම්බන්ධතාවය Jහහෝ පියවරෙ මාලාව බලන්න.

# Shell example (not SQL):
mysqldump -u user -p --single-transaction shop > shop.sql
mysql -u user -p restored_shop < shop.sql
Expected result: Exports and restores a logical backup if permissions and target schema exist.

Interview question: What are RPO and RTO?
Answer: Recovery point objective is tolerable data loss; recovery time objective is tolerable downtime.
Practice: Plan a restore drill using a test database.
